screening_decisions.reason: This is a before-and-after quasi-experimental study comparing PHC villages with non-PHC villages. No randomization is described. The study design does not meet the RCT criterion.

While this is an RCT, it tests malaria chemoprophylaxis (Maloprim vs placebo) administered by TBAs. The intervention is not TBA training but rather a drug intervention. TBAs were merely the delivery mechanism.
This is an observational study comparing three groups (trained TBA, tetanus toxoid, control) without randomization. Does not meet the RCT criterion.
This is a field trial with intervention vs control area but no randomization is described. Additionally, the focus is on childhood pneumonia management, not pregnancy outcomes.
This is a Cochrane review protocol/overview, not an RCT.
This is a methodological paper about funnel plots and meta-analysis bias detection, not an RCT about TBA training.
This is a survey validation study examining women's recall of obstetric complications. Not an RCT.
While this is an RCT, it compares two teaching methods (lecture vs interactive) for TBAs, not trained vs untrained TBAs. The comparison does not match the selection criteria.
This is a field trial with intervention and control villages but no randomization is described. Does not meet the RCT criterion.
This is a controlled study comparing communities with and without trained TBAs, but no randomization is described. Does not meet the RCT criterion.
This is a review/critique of a meta-analysis, not an RCT.

This is a cluster randomised controlled trial comparing trained TBAs (intervention: neonatal resuscitation training + amoxicillin) vs untrained TBAs (control: standard care with basic obstetric skills and clean delivery kits). Meets all selection criteria.
This is a review/opinion article summarizing systematic reviews and meta-analyses, not an RCT.
This is a retrospective case series from a teaching hospital, not an RCT.
This is a time-series experimental study (pre-post design) without randomization. Does not meet the RCT criterion.

This is a cluster-randomized controlled trial comparing areas with trained TBAs (intervention: TBA training + delivery kits + LHW linkage + obstetrical outreach) vs areas with usual care (control). Meets all selection criteria.
While this is an RCT, the intervention is women's groups, not TBA training. Both intervention and control clusters received basic TBA training, so the comparison is not trained vs untrained TBAs.
This is a systematic review of causes of maternal death, not an RCT.
This is a quasi-experimental study with before-after design comparing intervention and non-intervention communities. No randomization is described. Does not meet the RCT criterion.
While this is an RCT, the intervention is breastfeeding promotion, not TBA training. Does not meet the selection criteria.
This is a longitudinal study with intervention and comparison areas but no randomization is described. Does not meet the RCT criterion.
This is an observational community-based study comparing outcomes in different delivery settings. Not an RCT.
This is a policy document/position paper from a global meeting, not an RCT.
This is a qualitative study about identity work in demanding occupations (Episcopal priests), not an RCT about TBA training.
While this is an RCT, the intervention is nutrition counselling through multiple channels. TBAs were one of many counselling channels, not the focus of training comparison.
This is a methodological paper about statistical tests for meta-analysis, not an RCT about TBA training.

This includes a cluster-randomized controlled trial component comparing birth attendants trained in Neonatal Resuscitation Program vs control clusters with standard care. Meets the selection criteria for RCT comparing trained vs untrained birth attendants.
This is a prospective validation study examining women's reporting accuracy of obstetric complications. Not an RCT.
This is a cross-sectional survey of TBAs' knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Not an RCT.
This is a trial with intervention and non-intervention areas but no randomization is described. Does not meet the RCT criterion.
This is a review/overview article about neonatal mortality epidemiology, not an RCT.

This is a cluster-randomised effectiveness trial comparing areas with LHWs working with trained TBAs delivering an intervention package vs control areas with routine care. Meets the selection criteria for RCT comparing women in areas served by trained TBAs.
This is a validation study of verbal autopsy methodology, not an RCT.
